$comment: Toonflow v2.0.5 原生 MCP 连接契约（协议客户端实测用，非全局挂载）。端点/凭证路径来自官方源码 packages/mcp/README.md 与 apps/server/src/utils/mcp/*.ts。
client_mode_note: 本配置供 scripts/verify-mcp.mjs 作为独立 MCP 协议客户端直连 Toonflow；与把 MCP server 挂载进 Codex/ZCode 全局配置是两回事，本仓库不改任何全局 MCP 配置。

server.fallback_path: same-origin /mcp on the main server port 3000 (official behavior)

token_source.redaction: never print token; evidence shows '<REDACTED>' only

enable_switch.note: official UI path is Settings->MCP; server deployment can pre-provision the same settings.json inside its own data dir

runtime_info.content: { pid, url, token } managed by the host; read for port/token, never echo token

stdio_entry: vendor/toonflow/build/mcp/stdio.js (built by `bun run build:mcp`; needs node>=20 or bun)

server_side_no_ui: runAgent (needs configured model; SKIPPED this round: paid LLM)
require_connected_page: canvas/node/document/panel tools (official README: 需要打开的 Toonflow 窗口或网页)

allowed_real_calls: tools/call workspaceFiles list/mkdir/writeBinary/readBinary/remove in a temp directory

tools/call openProject + getCanvas(include nodeTypes) + addNode + findCanvasNodes + getCanvasNodes + deleteNodes on a controlled mcp-verify-* fixture project (real page connection; cleanup in finally; repair1 R2)

verification_bounds.exit_codes: 0=pass; 1=failure (transport/HTTP/JSON-RPC/tool isError/assert); 2=usage/config; 3=canvas unavailable (no connected page) — nonzero is never a pass
